chapter.verse: Tua hi a, note' ading leh Laodicea khua-a omte' ading ahi zongin, kei tawh pumpi leh maitang kimu ngeilote khempeuh' ading ahi zongin, nakpi-in hahkat ka hihlam kong theisak nuam hi.

Tua ka cih ciangin itna sungah a kikhuikhawm a lungsimte uh hong thadimin Pasian' thusim ahi Khris theihna cingtaak ahi zongin, theihtelna lamah lungmuanna a kicing zihziah ahi zongin hong neih nading uh ahi hi.
Tua Khris sungah pilna leh thutheihna a manphapen teng khempeuh kiseel hi.
Tua bang ka cih ciangin a lunglut-huai thugennate tawh kuamah in note hong zolkhiat loh nading ahi hi.
A hang pen pumpi tawh kong om loh hangin kha tawh kong ompih a, paizia hoih na neihna uh leh Khris sungah upna kiptak na neihna uh mu ka hih manin ka lungdam hi.
Tua ahih manin Khris Jesu Topa na san mah bangun ama' sungah nungta un.
Hong kihilhsa om bangin ama' sungah zungthuk kha-in kilambeh unla, upna sungah thakhauh semsemin hehpih phatna tawh na kidim un.
Khris' hong hilh ahilo, khanglui zatngeizia leh leitunga gamtang khate tunga kilam ahi, hong khem thei thuthuk ngaihsut pilna a hawmpi tawh kuamah ii galmat samat na suahkhak loh nading uh kidawm un.
A hang pen Khris' sungah pumpi lim tawh Pasian' cingtaakna bup a teeng hi a,
zaliatna leh uktheihna thu khempeuh ii lutang ahi tua Khris' sungah note a cingtaak a suak na hi uh hi.
Ama' vun-atte zong na hita uh a, tua pen khut kizang vun-atna nam tawh hilo-in cilesa pumpi suahkhiatna nam ahi—Khris' vun-atna nam hi.
Baptizena ah Khris tawh a kivui khin na hih manun misite' lakpan amah a thokiksak, a gamtang Pasian' vangliatna na upna uh tungtawnin amah tawh hong kithokiksak ahi hi.
Pasian in i tatkhialhna khempeuh pan hong maisak ciangin tatkhialhna hang leh cilesa vun-atlohna hangin misi ahi note zong Khris tawh a nungta hong suaksakkhawm hi.
Tua bang a pian nadingin amah in eite hong langneih, thubullette hanga piang leiba ciaptehna lai hong phiatmaisak a, tua laidal lakhia-in singlamteh tungah kilhcip hi.
Zaliante leh ukna thuneite a galvan uh hawkkhiatsakin tangpi' mai-ah selpho a, Khris' hangin tuate' tungah galzawhna pawi khaam hi.
Tua ahih manin annek tuidawn vai, ahihkeileh pawi vai, khadet ni vai, Sabbath vai, cihte ah kuamah' thukhen dingin om kei un.
Hihte pen hong tung ding thute ii a liim hi a, a tak ahihleh Khris ahi hi.
Kineusektawmna leh vanmite biakna paaina ah nuam a sa, muhkhak thute' tungah a kinga, cilesa lungsim tawh thu omlo pi-a kisathei mite khat mahmah ii hawmthawh dingin na kiphal kei un.

Pumpi bup pen sazangduai leh sagolhte tawh a kipehkhawm, a kibuptuah hi a, lutang tawh a kizop manin Pasian' kiangpan hong pai khangliatna nam tawh a khanglian hinapi, tua mite in lutang lenkip lo uh hi.
Leitunga gamtang khate vai ah Khris tawh a si khin na hih uhleh bang hangin leitung ah a nungta lai bang khatin zeh nuai-ah om na hi uh hiam?
“Lawng kei in! Ciam kei in! Sukha kei in!” cihte pen
mihing' thuciinte leh kihilhnate a kibulphuh hi a, tua nate a kizat khit ciangin a vekpi-in a muat ahi hi.
Hih bangte pen phuahtawm biakna, kineusektawmna, cilesa ngattak kidaamna, pumpi nakpi gimsakna cih teng hangin pilna thu hihtuak napi cilesa deihzulna tawpsan nadingin kimanna nei lo uh hi.
